citation.authors: Slonka GF, Fleissner ML et al

cited_by.title: Dry, itchy, flaky scalp and dandruff

record.population: School pupils in Buffalo, New York, 1972 to 1973
record.finding: In one elementary school 20% of white pupils and no Black pupils were infested; city-wide 7.2% of pupils were infested. Hair length was apparently not a factor.
